display_long_description:
Meta Quest 3 isn't just for watching videos — it can be the 3D camera you carry with you every day.

SpatialCam Lite captures SBS stereoscopic photos and videos on Meta Quest 3/3S using Passthrough cameras. The app is **free to download**; advanced features require **optional in-app purchases** through the Meta Horizon Store.

**Free plan (no purchase)**
- Stereoscopic photo capture (SBS, 2560×960) — **unlimited**
- Stereoscopic video recording — **up to 10 seconds per clip** (recording stops automatically; the clip is still saved to your gallery)
- Recording settings (frame rate, bitrate, optional microphone audio)
- On-device gallery and video management

**Pro unlock (optional, in-app purchase)**
- **Unlimited recording length**
- **YouTube 3D conversion** (re-encode SBS clips for YouTube 3D upload)
- **Monthly** $1.99 or **yearly** $9.99 (auto-renews; cancel anytime; price as shown in store)
- **Lifetime** $19.99 one-time — unlock Pro forever (no subscription required)
- View subscription / lifetime status in-app; restore purchases supported

**Discover 3D & VR Videos**
- Opens a curated 3D/VR video discovery page in your browser (https://tendy.net/)

**Also included**
- Dual Passthrough cameras with real-time SBS preview
- H.264 stereo video at 2560×960, recording timer
- Subscribe button always available on the toolbar
- All media saved locally on your headset — **no ads**

Try free 3D photos today; unlock Pro when you need longer clips or YouTube 3D export.
